name: smwgraphics-super-mario-bros-mario
title: Super Mario Bros. - Mario
description:
This is probably the best thing I'll ever make.

I used the "New Old Super Mario Bros." Sheet found on The Spriter's Resource as a reference for some of the sprites, so credit to Artie, Rapid the Hedgehog, MarioBegins, and PolarKoala. Around 90% of this is custom made by me. Credit not needed, but I would like it if you did.

UPDATE: Added 8-Bit cape to go with Mario, Added 8-Bit Overworld Yoshis, and fixed Mario's sideways Overworld walking, so he now bounces when moving.
